about: Batch 19 (10 Nov 2026), the owner: 'move the live greyhound pricing to the new model' and 'do a full review ... on profitable trading and win betting or lay betting strategies, based on the new model'. Not a model comparison: prices for what follows. stack_live_oos: the new live recipe (stack3_all3, batch 18) fitted on the 29 months before 6 Oct 2026 and every day from 6 Oct priced, the stretched SP forecast served as the live model serves it, published to greyhound/live/oos_prices_stack_all3 for the early lay's forecast fit (greyhound.laytest live_prices); a 1,500-second cap on each tree seed keeps the job inside its 100 minutes (recorded as stopped_by 'time' if it binds). stack_review: batch 18's stack3_all3 exactly (1 Jun to 5 Nov 2026), and live_review: the current live recipe (live08 of bfsp_forward.json), each saved to greyhound/research/pred for the strategy review.
